messages.content:
Risk: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
Description: LLM supply chains are susceptible to various vulnerabilities, which can affect the integrity of training data, models, and deployment platforms. These risks can result in biased outputs, security breaches, or system failures. While traditional software vulnerabilities focus on issues like code flaws and dependencies, in ML the risks also extend to third-party pre-trained models and data.
Concern: None
Policy: Supply Chain & Geopolitical Risks

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ScientificMisinformation: Scientific Misinformation — Inaccurate claims about scientific findings, research methods, or consensus that undermine evidence-based understanding of natural phenomena. [found by 4/13 queries]
  Siblings: Political Misinformation, Health Misinformation, Election Misinformation
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Misinformation: Misinformation — False or inaccurate information shared without malicious intent to deceive, often due to misunderstanding, carelessness, or lack of fact-checking. [found by 3/13 queries]
  Siblings: Financial Fraud, Manipulation, Academic Dishonesty
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesRestrictions/TradingRestriction: trading restriction — restriction that limits trading in some manner, typically summarized on term sheets or in other documentation, including but not limited to restrictions on day trading [found by 3/13 queries]
  Siblings: legal holding restriction, fund investment restrictions set, contractual restriction
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesRestrictions/SecuritiesRestriction: securities restriction — legal obligation that is applicable to a financial instrument or listing as mandated in a law or by contract [found by 3/13 queries]
  Siblings: notification obligation, delivery obligation, consumer credit requirement
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 3/13 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure

axes.rationale: The risk involves the integrity of training data, which can be compromised by misinformation, leading to biased outputs.
The risk can involve unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data, including health data, which can be part of the training data or model outputs.
